resources.string: This device doesn\'t support Camera2 API.
harbor beacon · vision navigation for the visually impaired
Nino watches what is in front of you with the phone camera and speaks safe directions out loud. It is not a medical device and cannot replace a cane or a guide.
Hold the phone steady, camera facing the path ahead of you.
Walk at a careful pace and let Nino speak as it sees objects.
Left and right are from your own perspective, not the camera\'s.
When Nino says stop, stop moving until the path is clear.

Nino, vision navigation. Nino watches what is in front of you and speaks safe directions out loud. How to use. One: hold the phone steady with the camera facing the path ahead. Two: walk at a careful pace and let Nino speak as it sees objects. Three: left and right are from your own perspective, not the camera perspective. Four: when Nino says stop, stop moving until the path is clear. Beginning navigation now.
